description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a press conference alongside state elected officials and local law enforcement leaders to discuss why law enforcement organizations and officials are lining up behind his campaign, as well as Roy Cooper’s failure to keep our communities safe. Whatley and the other speakers highlighted Roy Cooper’s release of more than 4,200 convicted criminals from prison, over 50% of which went on to commit another crime, and the soft on crime judges Cooper appointed as primary reasons why law enforcement continues to support Michael Whatley.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley, State Leaders, and Law Enforcement Officials Call Out Roy Cooper’s Soft on Crime Record in Cabarrus County – Michael Whatley for Senate
